
## Installing

GameMate updates itself to this version. To install it for the first time, download `GameMate-Setup-<version>.exe` below and run it. Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed yet: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

The eSpeak NG source code and build script for this version are attached below as `espeak-ng-1.52.0-source.tar.gz` and `gamemate-espeak-build.tar.gz`.
